Frequently Asked Questions

Seavy Kitchen Chimney Service FAQs in Zirakpur

Everything you need to know about our visiting charges, appointment scheduling, spare parts warranty, and diagnostic process.

Under standard conditions, our technician can reach your doorstep within 60 to 90 minutes of booking confirmation in Zirakpur. Availability depends on your locality and the time of booking, and you can choose a preferred time slot.

A visiting or inspection fee starts from ₹199 for most appliances. If you approve the repair, the visiting charge is adjusted in the final bill. The estimate for Seavy kitchen chimney repair is shared before any work begins.

Eligible repair work may include a 30-day service warranty. Coverage, exclusions and claim requirements depend on the written warranty terms shared for the service.

The most common culprit is heavy grease clogging the baffle or mesh filters, or oil coating the blower fan blades. In auto-clean chimneys a faulty heating coil can stop the oil from draining. A deep clean or duct unblocking normally restores suction.

For regular Indian cooking with spices and deep frying, a thorough deep clean every 3 to 6 months is recommended. Baffle filters should be washed at home every 2 to 3 weeks to reduce motor load.

Worn motor bearings, an unbalanced or oil-coated impeller, or loose mounting usually cause noise and vibration. Early repair avoids a motor burn-out.

Yes, touch panels, switches and control boards can be tested and repaired or replaced, depending on the model and part availability.

Auto-clean models have a heating element and oil collector in addition to the motor. They need more careful servicing, so the cost can be higher than for a baffle-filter chimney.
